branch: cutEl (50-blocks.js) makes the marker clickable when the row carries opts — a live row keeps its uncut text in fullTexts[] (dataset.full) and a replayed row carries its tool id (dataset.tool/which); the #log click delegate (00-core.js) sends {kind:'openText', title, text} or {kind:'openTool', id, which, title}; a spill marker (dataset.path) still sends {kind:'open', path} and reads 'open full output'; Kotlin: ChatPanel → ClaudeSessionService.openText (a read-only LightVirtualFile in FileEditorManager) / toolText (SessionStore.toolText scans the live transcript for the tool_use input or tool_result text). Card command previews (.cmd-cut) stay plain.
provenance: Pure page behaviour driven through the wire: the Bash tool_use / tool_result frames are fixture 07's shapes with a long body (400 lines, > OUT_MAX 2000) and a long command (> CMD_MAX 4000) — the caps are RenderLimits' (docs/limits.md), nothing new is claimed about the CLI. `__transcript` items are what SessionStore serialises for a replayed tool (55-replay.js reads cmd/cmdCut/out/outCut/outTotal/outFile; `toolId` is new, pinned Kotlin-side by SessionStoreToolTextTest on the real replay-sample.jsonl). The bridge is taped for the fixture's duration and restored in the last step, so no click reaches the live IDE. What the IDE opens (LightVirtualFile, read-only) is Swing and out of this harness's reach — hand-verified in the sandbox (§17 MT-1.27). VS Code's contract for comparison (reference extension.js): `open_content(content, fileName, editable:false)` on click of any IN/OUT body over 250 chars — ours hangs it on the cut marker instead, because the row's own click is already the fold toggle. NEGATIVE CONTROL: run against the sandbox still serving the pre-change webview — RUN 2026-09-05 (sandbox launched before the JS edit, fixture written first): 14 FAILED / 7 passed / 0 aborts — the passes are GUARDs that hold on both builds (the marker count, the not-spill wording, the spill step and the card step); a first draft aborted the harness on `.click()` of a missing marker, so every click is null-guarded.
